spec.label: R-I047-1
spec.notes: Link 1: at the parent (77b36f5), _run_shadow_prediction calls predict_local_shadow without heartbeat_watchdog, so the patched watchdog is never called and mock_watchdog.assert_called_once_with(...) raises AssertionError (line 48 at 150ed4c, unique). Link 2: the parent never checks for an existing shadow pick, so it calls the patched predict_local_shadow, and mock_predict.assert_not_called() raises AssertionError (line 72, unique). In that test the MagicMock predictions make the parent's real select_pick return None at `if predictions.empty`, and the function returns normally. Both AssertionErrors come from unittest.mock; the runner's innermost repo frame (venv excluded) is the test line. All other work in the parent's function runs inside its broad `except Exception`, so no other exception can surface. Static checks: _run_shadow_prediction(config, date, production_pick_name) keeps its signature at the parent; the module's autouse fixture patches bts.strategy._load_mdp, which exists there. In the first test the parent also runs the real attach_provenance on the MagicMock daily, exactly as F does.
